Jamuna Bank joins Tk10,000cr BB agricultural refinance scheme
results.description: Jamuna Bank PLC has joined Bangladesh Bank's Tk10,000 crore refinance scheme aimed at increasing agricultural production, strengthening food security and supporting the rural economy. The two institutions signed a participation agreement on 16 August, according to a press release. Under the three-year revolving refinance scheme, financing will be available for a wide range of agricultural and rural activities, including crop production, fisheries, livestock, agricultural and irrigation machinery, and other income-generating activities. results.title: CCTV off, phone wiped clean: Police probe if Bengaluru child was killed for witnessing dad's murder
results.description: Police arrested Harini for allegedly killing her husband and son. She reportedly conspired with her lover, Vinay, to commit the murders. The child was allegedly strangled after witnessing his father's death. Investigators suspect property was a motive for the alleged double murder. Harini confessed to the killings during police interrogation.
